items.title: 优化 story_review 返回结构化摘要
items.context: 根据实验最佳候选 r09-json-concise，把 summary/issues/_hint/_reviewPrompt 的高价值字段前置，减少用户先看到长 truth source 的噪音。

happy.desc: story_review 有 missing_intent blocker → 输出 summary/issues/actionSummary，并把 nextFix 指向补 testIntent

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/story-review-structured-output.json:4 — missing-intent verifies actionSummary nextFix points to missing testIntent blocker | severity:info

edge.desc: story_review 只有 advisory 无 blocker → actionSummary 表示可进入开发或人工复核，而不是误报 blocker

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/story-review-structured-output.json:18 — advisory-only verifies canEnterDev true and no false blocker | severity:info

adversarial.desc: 高风险 story 缺 decision/preMortem → reviewPromptSummary 标出 decision/preMortem 缺失并保留完整 _reviewPrompt

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/story-review-structured-output.json:33 — high-risk verifies missing decision/preMortem summarized | severity:info

items.title: 保留完整 reviewPrompt 追溯能力
items.context: 不能为了压缩输出丢掉 reviewer 所需上下文；完整 prompt 可保留在字段中，但 compare/CLI 首屏应先展示摘要。

happy.desc: story_review 返回仍包含完整 _reviewPrompt → reviewer agent 可继续读取完整上下文

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/story-review-structured-output.json:48 — missing-intent verifies full _reviewPrompt remains present | severity:info

edge.desc: reviewPromptSummary 存在但 _reviewPrompt 为空异常 → 测试应失败，防止摘要替代完整 prompt

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/story-review-structured-output.json:63 — missing-intent verifies summary does not replace full prompt | severity:info

adversarial.desc: 长 truth source 存在时 → summary/actionSummary 仍在顶层，完整 prompt 只作为追溯字段

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/story-review-structured-output.json:78 — high-risk verifies long prompt still has top-level summary fields | severity:info

items.title: 补 story_review 输出回归验证
items.context: 验证 story_review 对 missing_intent、riskSignals、decision/preMortem、intentCoverage 和 actionable hint 的输出结构。

happy.desc: story_review 输出回归 fixture → 覆盖 missing_intent/riskSignals/intentCoverage/actionSummary/reviewPromptSummary

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/story-review-structured-output.json:93 — missing-intent covers new structured fields | severity:info

edge.desc: 旧字段 summary/issues/_hint/_reviewPrompt 仍存在 → 兼容旧调用方

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/story-review-structured-output.json:108 — advisory-only confirms legacy summary/issues/_hint/_reviewPrompt fields remain | severity:info

adversarial.desc: review 输出不含 actionSummary 或 reviewPromptSummary → 回归失败

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/story-review-structured-output.json:123 — high-risk would fail if actionSummary/reviewPromptSummary were missing | severity:info
